vraag:
SECTION A: ESSAY

QUESTION 1

Write an essay on the topic below. Your essay may be narrative, descriptive, reflective, discursive or argumentative.
Write the number and the title of the essay at the top, e.g. 1.X Nobody saw that coming.
Plan your essay first. Spend about 80 minutes on this section.

1.X Nobody saw that coming [50]

NOTE: Your essay should be 250 to 300 words long.
beplanning: Essay type: narrative. Plan one story with a clear beginning, a problem (complication), a turning point and an ending that surprises the reader.
Decide what the unexpected event is and who it surprises. Build towards it step by step, with one event per paragraph.
Use the past tense for the story, a little dialogue, one or two vivid images and a strong final line that links back to the title.
formaat: Question number and title written at the top (e.g. 1.X Nobody saw that coming)
Clear introduction that sets up the character and situation
Body paragraphs that build the story line towards a turning point
Interesting, surprising ending that links back to the title
Story told in the past tense with one consistent narrator (first or third person); a short present-tense reflection at the end is acceptable
Each new idea or event in a new paragraph; dialogue punctuated correctly
Essay between 250 and 300 words (the title is not counted)
antwoord:
1.X Nobody saw that coming

For six months I sold sandwiches outside the clinic in Mamelodi every Saturday. Every coin went into a small red purse, and by October it held R1 200, enough for the green dress I had dreamed about for the matric farewell.

On the day I went to buy it, the taxi rank was a sea of pushing shoulders and shouting drivers. I held my bag tightly, but somewhere between the fruit stalls and the taxi, the purse disappeared. When I realised it, my heart dropped like a stone.

I immediately thought of the thin boy in a torn jersey who had bumped into me near the stalls. 'It must be him,' I told my mother that evening, and I cried until I fell asleep.

A week later, there was a soft knock at our door. When I opened it, my breath caught in my throat. There stood the same boy, holding my red purse in both hands.

'I saw a man take it from your bag,' he said quietly. 'I followed him for two streets until he dropped it. Your school card was inside, so I asked people where you live.' I counted the money with shaking fingers. Not a single rand was missing.

How could I have judged him so quickly? I had looked at his torn jersey and decided who he was. His name was Lebo. He refused the R200 I offered him and took only a sandwich. Today he helps me at my stall every Saturday, and he is saving for his own school shoes. I wore the green dress to the farewell, but the most valuable thing I gained that year was a friend nobody saw coming.
verduideliking: This narrative essay has a strong story line: a goal (the dress), a problem (the stolen purse), a wrong assumption, a turning point (the knock at the door) and a surprising ending. Paragraphs are short and connected, the story is told consistently in the past tense, with a short present-tense reflection at the end, and the dialogue is punctuated correctly. Imagery, a rhetorical question and a final line that echoes the title lift the language without sounding adult or forced. Common mistakes: retelling events with no real surprise or ending, switching tense by accident in the middle of the story, and writing far more than 300 words so that the story loses focus.

vraag:
SECTION A: ESSAY

QUESTION 1

- Your essay on the topic below should be 250 to 300 words long.
- At the top of your page, write the question number and the title exactly as given.
- You should use about 80 minutes for this section.

1.X Machines cannot replace a good teacher [50]
beplanning: Audience and purpose: decide who will read your essay and what you want them to believe. Use a formal, confident tone.
Choose ONE clear position (agree or disagree with the topic) and state it in your introduction.
Plan three different arguments, one per paragraph. Support each one with a concrete example or piece of evidence.
Admit the other side in a short paragraph and answer it. End with a strong conclusion that restates your view, gives a recommendation and closes with a memorable line.
formaat: Write the question number and the exact title (1.X Machines cannot replace a good teacher)
Introduction states a clear position for or against the topic
Each body paragraph develops one argument with an example or evidence
The opposing view is acknowledged and answered
Conclusion is a strong, clear and convincing statement of the writer's opinion
Formal register, first person allowed, no slang or contractions
Body between 250 and 300 words (the title is not counted)
antwoord:
1.X Machines cannot replace a good teacher

Imagine a classroom with no teacher at the front, only a screen that answers every question in seconds. Many believe this is the future, because artificial intelligence can now write essays, solve sums and explain almost anything. I strongly disagree. A machine can give information, but it can never replace a good teacher.

Firstly, teaching is about people, not only facts. A good teacher notices when a learner is quiet because there is trouble at home. Last year my Mathematical Literacy teacher saw that I was struggling and stayed after school to help me. No computer program could have seen the fear in my eyes.

Secondly, a teacher builds character. Learners learn respect and discipline from the adults who guide them. When I failed my first Tourism test, my teacher did not simply mark my mistakes in red. She told me about her own failures and encouraged me to try again. An app can correct my spelling, but can it teach me to keep going when I fail?

Thirdly, we must think about the reality in South Africa. Many learners do not have laptops, and data is expensive. When load-shedding switches off the power, the machine goes silent, but the teacher keeps teaching with a piece of chalk.

Of course, artificial intelligence is a useful tool. It never becomes tired or impatient, and it can help learners to practise at home. However, a tool should support the worker, not replace him or her.

In conclusion, technology may be clever, but it does not have a heart. Instead of fearing technology, the government should train teachers to use it wisely. Let machines carry the heavy books; let teachers carry the future.
verduideliking: The essay states its position at the end of the first paragraph and never changes sides. Each body paragraph opens with a connecting word and develops one argument. Every argument has a concrete example: a teacher's extra help, a teacher's encouragement after a failed test, and load-shedding. The writer admits the strengths of AI and answers them, which makes the argument more convincing. The conclusion restates the view, gives a recommendation and ends with a memorable contrast. Common mistakes: writing a balanced discursive essay when a clear argument was chosen, repeating the same point in different words, and ending weakly without restating the opinion.

vraag:
SECTION A: ESSAY

QUESTION 1

• Write down the NUMBER and TITLE of your essay correctly.
• Spend approximately 80 minutes on this section.

1.X 'If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.' – African Proverb [50]

NOTE: You may write a narrative, descriptive, reflective, argumentative or discursive essay on this topic. There must be a clear link between your essay and the proverb.

Write an essay of between 250 and 300 words in length.
beplanning: The model answer is a REFLECTIVE essay. Its purpose is to reflect honestly on your own feelings and reactions and to show how your view of working alone versus working with others changed.
Plan: introduction (old belief: alone is faster), body (a real experience that tested this belief, your feelings during it, the turning point), conclusion (what you now understand about the proverb).
Link the essay clearly to BOTH halves of the proverb. Use one or two devices naturally, for example a rhetorical question, a simile or a strong closing line.
formaat: Question number and the full proverb as the title, with its attribution (– African Proverb)
Any essay type is acceptable if it links clearly to the proverb; the model answer is a reflective essay
Reflective essay: first-person voice in which the writer's reactions and feelings are central
Clear introduction, well-developed body paragraphs and a thoughtful conclusion
Clear link to the proverb (going fast alone versus going far together) at the start and the end
Varied sentences and a few natural stylistic devices (rhetorical question, simile, contrast)
Body between 250 and 300 words (the title is not counted)
antwoord:
1.X 'If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.' – African Proverb

For most of my school years, I believed that working alone was the smartest choice. Group work felt like a waste of time. Someone always arrived late, someone else did nothing, and I usually ended up doing everything myself. Why share the work when I could finish it faster on my own?

That belief was tested in Grade 11, when our Hospitality Studies teacher divided us into teams of four for a practical assessment. Each team had to prepare and serve a three-course meal for twenty guests in only three hours. My heart sank. I was paired with Kagiso, who was very quiet, Bongani, who joked constantly, and Anele, who had missed many classes.

At first, I tried to control everything. I chopped, stirred and gave orders like a nervous general, but within an hour the soup was burning and the dessert had not even been started. Then Kagiso quietly took over the timing, Bongani kept everyone calm with his jokes, and Anele, to my surprise, plated the food more beautifully than I ever could. Slowly, the chaos in that hot, noisy kitchen turned into a rhythm.

We served the last plate with two minutes to spare. When the guests applauded, I felt something I had never felt after working alone: pride that was shared, and therefore bigger. I realised that I had not been fast at all. I had simply been lonely, carrying a load that was never meant for one pair of hands.

Today, as I prepare for my final examinations with a study group, I still value my independence. However, I now understand the proverb: alone, I may go fast; together, we can go far.
verduideliking: The topic allows any essay type, but this model answer is a reflective essay, so the writer's feelings drive it: the old belief, the panic in the kitchen and the shared pride at the end. The paragraphs move logically from introduction to experience, turning point and insight. The proverb is linked clearly in the opening and in the closing line. Devices are used naturally: a rhetorical question, a simile ('like a nervous general'), contrast and a balanced final sentence. Common mistakes: retelling a story without reflecting on feelings, writing a general speech about teamwork that never links to the proverb, and ending suddenly without a clear insight.

vraag:
2.X LETTER OF APPLICATION

A family restaurant in your town has advertised a temporary position for a waiter during the December holidays. You are in Grade 12 and wish to apply for this position.

Write the letter of application.

NOTE: The body of your letter should be between 120 and 150 words.
beplanning: Audience: the manager of the restaurant, a stranger, so use a formal register with no contractions or slang.
Purpose: to apply for the holiday waiter post and convince the manager that you are suitable.
Cover three points: where and when you saw the advertisement; your relevant skills, experience and personal qualities; when you can start, that your CV is attached, and your request for an interview.
formaat: Sender's address, with the date below it
Recipient: The Manager, the name of the restaurant and its address on the left
Salutation (Dear Sir/Madam)
Subject line in capitals (RE: APPLICATION FOR THE POSITION OF ...)
Introduction, body and conclusion: purpose and the advertisement, then qualities and experience, then availability, the attached CV and a polite close
Formal register and tone throughout, with no contractions
Suitable ending (Yours faithfully), signature and name of sender
Body between 120 and 150 words (the addresses and date are not counted)
antwoord:
14 Protea Street
Bethlehem
9701
12 October 2026

The Manager
Riverside Family Restaurant
22 Church Street
Bethlehem
9701

Dear Sir/Madam

RE: APPLICATION FOR THE POSITION OF HOLIDAY WAITER

I wish to apply for the position of holiday waiter, which was advertised in the local newspaper on 5 October 2026.

I am a Grade 12 learner at Bethlehem High School, and I take Hospitality Studies as one of my subjects. Through this subject, I have learnt how to set a table, serve meals correctly and treat customers with respect. Last December, I also helped at my aunt's catering business, where I served guests at weddings and parties.

I am friendly, honest and hard-working. I remain calm under pressure, and I am always punctual.

I will be available to start work on 1 December 2026, after my final examinations. Please find my CV attached. I would appreciate the opportunity to attend an interview.

Yours faithfully

N. Khumalo
Naledi Khumalo
verduideliking: This letter has every format feature the marking guideline expects: the sender's address and date, the recipient's position, the restaurant's name and address, a salutation, a subject line, a suitable ending, a signature and a name. The introduction states the purpose and where the post was advertised. The body links real experience and personal qualities to the job, and the conclusion gives the start date, mentions the CV and asks for an interview. The register stays formal and polite. Common mistakes are leaving out the subject line or the recipient's address, ending with 'Yours sincerely' after 'Dear Sir/Madam', and using contractions or a chatty tone.

vraag:
2.X DIALOGUE

You have been offered a weekend job as a waiter at a restaurant in your town. Your father does not want you to accept the job because he believes it will interfere with your preparation for the final examinations. You disagree with him and have decided to talk to him about it.

Write the dialogue that takes place between you and your father.

The body of your dialogue should be between 120 and 150 words.
beplanning: Audience and tone: your father. Be respectful and calm. You disagree, but you are never rude. Use no slang.
Purpose: convince him to let you take the job by answering his worry about the examinations.
Three points to cover: (1) the hours are limited and you still study; (2) the job builds useful skills; (3) a reason that matters to the family, and a promise or compromise.
Ending: the conversation must reach a conclusion, for example an agreement, a trial period or a final decision.
formaat: Brief context or setting at the beginning of the dialogue
Speaker names written on the left side of the page
A colon after the name of each speaker
A new line for each new speaker
Actions or stage directions in brackets before the spoken words, where necessary
No quotation marks; natural but correct language with no slang
The conversation develops logically and reaches a clear conclusion
Body between 120 and 150 words (the heading is not counted)
antwoord:
2.X DIALOGUE

Context: Sipho and his father are sitting at the kitchen table after supper.

Father: Sipho, I have thought about the job. My answer is still no.
Sipho: (calmly) Please hear me out, Dad. It is only on Saturdays, from ten until four.
Father: That is six hours you could spend studying. Your examinations start soon.
Sipho: I know, but I study every evening. The job will teach me skills that I need for Hospitality Studies.
Father: (frowning) And if your schoolwork suffers?
Sipho: Then I will resign immediately. I promise.
Father: (after a long pause) Why does this matter so much?
Sipho: I want to save for my college registration fee so that you do not pay everything alone.
Father: (smiling) You have thought this through. We will try it for one month.
Sipho: (hugging him) Thank you, Dad.
verduideliking: This dialogue gives a brief context, writes the speaker names on the left followed by colons and starts a new line for every speaker. It puts the actions in brackets before the words. The tone is respectful: Sipho disagrees but answers each worry calmly. The argument develops from the facts (the hours) to a promise and then to an emotional reason. This leads to a clear compromise, a one-month trial. Common mistakes are using quotation marks or writing the dialogue like a story, using slang or a rude tone towards a parent, and ending without any resolution.

vraag:
3.X DIARY ENTRIES

For months you have been practising for your driving licence test. The test is booked for early on a Wednesday morning at the traffic department in your town, and you pass it.

Write TWO diary entries: one on the night before the test and one after you have received the result. Both entries must show how you feel, and your feelings must clearly change from the first entry to the second.

NOTE: Your two entries together should be 80–100 words long.
beplanning: Audience and purpose: you are writing only for yourself, so use the first person, an informal register and honest feelings, but no slang.
Entry 1 (the night before): nerves, fears about mistakes and how you prepared.
Entry 2 (after the test): the good news, your relief and pride, and a clear contrast with how you felt the night before.
formaat: TWO separate diary entries
Day, date and time at the top of EACH entry
Written in the first person (I, me, my)
Simple, informal but correct language: no slang, abbreviations or SMS language
Feelings and reactions are central, and the tone matches the emotions
The second entry shows a clear change in feelings
Body between 80 and 100 words (dates and times are counted)
antwoord:
Tuesday, 13 October 2026
20:45

Dear Diary

Tomorrow is my driving test at the traffic department, and I cannot sit still. What if I forget to check my mirrors or stall the car on the hill? Dad has let me practise parallel parking all week. I hope my hands stop shaking before then.

Wednesday, 14 October 2026
11:30

Dear Diary

I passed! The examiner shook my hand and said I had driven carefully. Last night fear kept me awake; this morning I feel as light as a feather. Freedom, here I come!
verduideliking: Each entry has its own day, date and time. The second entry is written soon after the turning point, the test result. The writer uses the first person throughout. The first entry shows fear through restlessness and a rhetorical question. The second entry opens with an exclamation of joy and uses a simile, "as light as a feather". Contrast ("Last night ... this morning") shows the change in feelings. The register is informal but error-free. Common mistakes are leaving out the date or time, retelling events without expressing feelings, and using slang or SMS language such as "OMG" or "gr8".

vraag:
3.X INSTRUCTIONS

Your younger brother has just started Grade 8 and must now iron his own school shirts. Every morning he asks you to do it for him because he is afraid of burning the shirt. Your parents have asked you to write clear instructions so that he can learn to iron his school shirt himself.

Write the instructions.

NOTE: Do NOT include illustrations or drawings. The body of your instructions should be between 80 and 100 words.
beplanning: Who is reading? A Grade 8 learner with no experience. Keep the language simple, clear and direct.
Purpose: he must be able to iron a shirt safely and neatly on his own.
Plan the order: what he needs, then preparation (label, heat, water), then the parts of the shirt from small to large, then hanging the shirt and switching off the iron safely.
formaat: A clear heading or title (e.g. HOW TO IRON A SCHOOL SHIRT)
Optional short list of what is needed
Steps in a logical sequence from start to finish
Every step written in the imperative (e.g. Read..., Spray..., Iron...)
Numbered points or short paragraphs; each step short and clear
Clear and concise; no illustrations or drawings
Body between 80 and 100 words (the heading is not counted)
antwoord:
HOW TO IRON A SCHOOL SHIRT

You will need: an iron, an ironing board, a spray bottle and a hanger.

1. Read the label and set the iron to the correct heat.
2. Spray the shirt lightly with water to loosen stubborn creases.
3. Iron the collar first, moving from the points towards the middle.
4. Press the cuffs, then iron each sleeve flat along its seam.
5. Iron the back, then the front panels, working carefully around the buttons.
6. Hang the shirt immediately so that it stays smooth.
7. Unplug the iron and let it cool safely.
verduideliking: These instructions work because they begin with a heading and a short list of what is needed. They then follow a logical order: preparation first, then the small parts of the shirt (collar and cuffs) before the large parts, and safety at the end. Every step starts with a verb in the imperative (Read, Spray, Iron, Press, Hang, Unplug), and each numbered point is short and clear. The register is direct and simple, which suits a young reader. Common mistakes: writing a story or a letter instead of steps ("First I take the iron..."), putting the steps in an illogical order, and adding drawings or long explanations that push the body over 100 words.

vraag:
AFDELING A: OPSTEL

VRAAG 1

Skryf 'n opstel oor die onderwerp hieronder. Skryf die nommer en die titel van die onderwerp bo-aan jou opstel neer. Jy mag die onderwerp letterlik of figuurlik interpreteer.

1.1 Die kortpad was die langste pad van my lewe [50]

Jou opstel moet 400 tot 450 woorde lank wees.
beplanning: Besluit eers of jy die onderwerp letterlik ('n werklike pad) of figuurlik ('n maklike uitweg in die lewe) gaan interpreteer.
Beplan 'n storielyn met 'n duidelike begin, 'n spanningslyn wat opbou en 'n hoogtepunt.
Dink aan 'n slot wat die leser verras, maar steeds by die titel aansluit.
Laat die atmosfeer en die verteller se gevoelens deur konkrete besonderhede spreek.
formaat: Nommer en titel bo-aan die opstel
Treffende inleiding wat die leser dadelik boei
Logiese, samehangende paragrawe wat spanning opbou
Oortuigende karakters en geslaagde atmosfeer
Verrassende slot wat by die onderwerp aansluit
Die vertelling is konsekwent in die verlede tyd; die slot mag na die hede terugkeer
Liggaam tussen 400 en 450 woorde (die titel tel nie)
antwoord:
1.1 Die kortpad was die langste pad van my lewe

Mis het soos nat watte oor die veld gehang toe ek die hekkie by die ou steengroef oopstoot. Ma se stem het in my kop gesê: "Neem die teerpad, Lindi. Altyd die teerpad." Maar dit was amper sewe-uur, my telefoon se battery het op drie persent geflikker en die kortpad sou my twintig minute spaar. Wat kon tog verkeerd gaan?

Die eerste paar honderd meter was maklik. Die voetpaadjie het tussen die doringbosse deur gekronkel en ek kon nog die straatligte van ons dorp agter my sien. Toe het die mis dikker geword. Die ligte het een vir een verdwyn, asof iemand hulle doodgeblaas het, en skielik was daar net ek, die koue en die geritsel van droë gras.

Dit was toe dat ek die voetstappe gehoor het. Sag. Versigtig. Altyd 'n entjie agter my. As ek gaan staan, het hulle ook gaan staan. My hart het soos 'n trommel teen my ribbes geslaan. Ek het vinniger begin loop, toe gedraf. My asem het in wit wolkies voor my uitgeslaan.

Toe het die grond onder my voete eenvoudig verdwyn.

Klippe en grond het saam met my afgerol tot ek met 'n slag op 'n rotsrand bo-in die steengroef tot stilstand gekom het. 'n Skerp pyn het deur my enkel geskiet. Ek het na my telefoon gegryp, maar die skerm het net een keer geflikker en toe donker geword.

Bo my, op die rand, het die voetstappe weer begin. Stadig. Nader. Ek het my oë styf toegeknyp en gewag.

Iets warms en nats het oor my wang gelek.

Dit was Wagter, oom Sakkie se ou skaaphond, wat elke middag by ons hek kom bedel vir 'n stukkie brood. Hy het my die hele pad gevolg, en ek was te bang om om te kyk.

Hy het styf teen my kom lê, en sy warm lyf het die ergste koue van my weggehou. Die ure het gekruip. Ek het aan Ma gedink wat al die hospitale sou bel, aan Pa wat met 'n flits deur die strate sou ry, en ek het my geskaam.

Dit was amper middernag toe Wagter skielik opgespring en begin blaf het. Hy het aanhou blaf totdat flitsligte bo die rand verskyn en iemand my naam geroep het.

Toe Ma die volgende oggend langs my bed sit, het sy niks gesê nie. Sy het net my hand vasgehou, en dit was erger as enige preek.

Twintig minute wou ek spaar. Dit het my vyf uur in die koue, ses weke op krukke en my ouers se vertroue gekos. Deesdae neem ek die teerpad. En elke middag kry Wagter 'n ekstra snytjie brood by ons hek.
verduideliking: Hierdie verhalende opstel interpreteer die onderwerp letterlik én figuurlik: die kortpad deur die ou steengroef word die langste nag van die verteller se lewe. Die inleiding boei dadelik met atmosfeer (mis soos nat watte) en 'n innerlike stem wat die konflik opstel. Spanning bou op deur kort, afgekapte sinne (Sag. Versigtig.) en die geheimsinnige voetstappe, met 'n hoogtepunt wanneer sy val. Die verrassing dat die voetstappe aan 'n hond behoort, ontlont die spanning op 'n geloofwaardige manier, en die slot keer terug na die titel deur die twintig minute teen vyf uur en ses weke op te weeg. Algemene foute: 'n storie wat net gebeure opsom sonder spanning of gevoel, 'n slot wat skielik ophou, wisseling tussen die verlede en die teenwoordige tyd, en 'n opstel wat ver bo of onder die woordgrens is.

vraag:
1.X Die skerm wat ons verbind, maak ons eensamer [50]

Skryf 'n ARGUMENTERENDE opstel oor die onderwerp hierbo. Gee jou opstel 'n titel. Die opstel moet 400 tot 450 woorde lank wees (die titel tel nie).
beplanning: Besluit eers of jy met die stelling saamstem of nie. Neem dan reeds in die inleiding 'n duidelike standpunt in.
Beplan drie of vier argumente en staaf elkeen met 'n voorbeeld uit die leefwêreld van Suid-Afrikaanse tieners.
Erken die sterkste teenargument kortliks en weerlê dit oortuigend.
Dink aan 'n slot wat by die inleiding aansluit en die leser tot nadenke of aksie aanspoor.
formaat: Titel bo-aan die opstel
Treffende inleiding waarin die standpunt duidelik gestel word
Elke argument staan in 'n eie paragraaf met 'n kernsin en 'n voorbeeld
Die teenstandpunt word erken en weerlê
Oorredende taal en stylmiddels, byvoorbeeld 'n retoriese vraag, kontras en beeldspraak
Slot wat by die inleiding aansluit en die standpunt kragtig bevestig
Liggaam tussen 400 en 450 woorde (die titel tel nie)
antwoord:
Die skerm wat ons verbind, maak ons eensamer

Dit is Vrydagaand. Vyf vriende sit om 'n tafel in 'n restaurant, maar niemand praat nie. Elkeen se gesig is in die blou lig van 'n selfoon gedompel. Hulle is saam, en tog is elkeen alleen. Ek is oortuig daarvan dat die skerm wat belowe om ons te verbind, ons in werklikheid eensamer maak.

In die eerste plek vervang aanlyn kontak die diepte van 'n regte gesprek. 'n Kort boodskap of 'n vrolike prentjie op die skerm kos geen moeite nie, en juis daarom beteken dit so min. Toe my vriendin oor haar ouers se egskeiding wou praat, kon geen boodskap die plek inneem van 'n uur saam op die bankie by die skool nie. Ware vriendskap word gebou deur stilte te deel, deur 'n hand op 'n skouer en deur te luister wanneer dit ongemaklik raak. 'n Skerm kan dit nie bied nie.

Tweedens lei sosiale media ons in 'n strik van vergelyking. Elke dag rol ons deur foto's van perfekte vakansies, partytjies en lywe. Ons weet dat dit net die hoogtepunte is, maar die hart glo die oë. Wie heeltyd na ander se volmaakte foto's staar, begin voel dat sy eie lewe vaal en onbelangrik is. Hoe meer aanlyn vriende ons het, hoe meer voel ons uitgesluit.

Derdens steel die skerm ons tyd saam met die mense reg voor ons. Hoeveel etenstafels in ons land is nie vanaand stil terwyl elke gesinslid na sy eie skerm staar nie? My oupa sê altyd dat 'n mens die mense wat jy liefhet, aan hulle stemme ken. Deesdae ken ons mekaar aan ons profielfoto's.

Sommige mense sal aanvoer dat die skerm juis eensaamheid verlig. 'n Student wat ver van die huis studeer, kan elke aand met sy ma 'n videogesprek voer, en iemand wat geboelie word, kan aanlyn ondersteuning vind. Dit is waar, maar dan is die skerm 'n brug na 'n mens, nie 'n plaasvervanger vir een nie. Die gevaar ontstaan wanneer ons op die brug bly staan en nooit oorstap nie.

Ek beweer nie dat ons ons selfone in die rivier moet gooi nie. Ek vra net dat ons dit weer as 'n werktuig gebruik en nie as 'n skuilplek nie. Sit dit weg wanneer julle saam eet. Bel eerder as om te tik. Gaan kuier by die vriend wat al weke lank stil is.

Onthou die vyf vriende om die tafel. Stel jou voor hoe anders daardie aand kon verloop het as elkeen sy foon omgedraai en opgekyk het. Die skerm het belowe om ons nader aan mekaar te bring. Dit is tyd dat ons self daardie belofte nakom.
verduideliking: Hierdie argumenterende opstel neem reeds in die inleiding 'n duidelike standpunt in, en die beeld van vyf stil vriende om 'n tafel trek die leser se aandag. Drie argumente volg, elk in sy eie paragraaf met 'n kernsin en 'n konkrete voorbeeld uit die leefwêreld van tieners. Die sterkste teenargument word eerlik erken en dan weerlê met die beeld van die skerm as 'n brug. Stylmiddels soos die retoriese vraag, kontras en beeldspraak versterk die oortuigingskrag, en die slot sluit sirkelvormig by die inleiding aan en spoor die leser tot aksie aan. Algemene foute: die skrywer swaai tussen standpunte heen en weer, argumente word sonder voorbeelde gelys, die teenstandpunt word geïgnoreer en die slot herhaal net die inleiding woordeliks.

Die liggaam van jou brief moet tussen 180 en 200 woorde lank wees.

ONWETTIGE STORTING BEDREIG ONS KINDERS

Elke oggend loop honderde kinders verby die oop terrein langs Laerskool Panorama op pad skool toe. Wat eens 'n grasveld was, het die afgelope ses maande in 'n stinkende vullishoop verander.

Inwoners en kontrakteurs stort snags puin, tuinafval en huishoudelike vullis op die terrein. Die gevolge is ernstig. Rotte en vlieë vermeerder, en die reuk dring tot in die klaskamers deur. Gebreekte glas en roesige blik lê waar kinders speel, en verlede week moes 'n jong leerder ná 'n diep sny hospitaal toe geneem word. Wanneer die hope aan die brand gesteek word, trek giftige rook oor die huise.

Die inwoners het reeds drie klagtes by die munisipaliteit ingedien, maar tot dusver is niks gedoen nie. Ek doen dus 'n beroep op die owerhede om die terrein te omhein, borde wat boetes aankondig op te rig en die vullis gereeld te verwyder. Die gemeenskap kan ook die skuldiges aanmeld en een Saterdag per maand help skoonmaak.

Ons kinders verdien 'n skoon en veilige omgewing. Hoe lank moet ons nog wag voordat iemand ernstig beseer word? Ek vertrou dat die munisipaliteit dringend sal optree.

Die uwe
M. Botha

Liewe Thandi

Jou lang boodskap van gisteraand het my hart swaar gemaak. Twee maande in Bloemfontein, 'n nuwe skool en nog niemand om saam mee te eet nie: dit klink eensaam, my vriendin.

Onthou jy hoe jy in graad 8 heeltemal alleen by ons skool aangekom het? Jy het toe ook gedink niemand sal ooit met jou praat nie, en kyk hoe dit uitgedraai het! Mense het net tyd nodig, nes 'n nuwe plantjie wat eers wortel moet skiet voordat dit kan blom.

Hier is my raad: sluit by die debatsklub of die koor aan. Jy sing mos soos 'n nagtegaal! Glimlag vir die meisie langs jou in die klas en vra haar 'n eenvoudige vraag oor die huiswerk. Klein gesprekkies word dikwels groot vriendskappe.

Hier by die huis is alles nog dieselfde, behalwe dat jou ou buurhond, Koffie, elke middag by julle hek gaan sit en wag. Ma stuur groete en belowe dat sy koeksisters sal bak wanneer jy in die vakansie kom kuier.

Bel my Saterdag, dan gesels ons lank. Jy is sterker as wat jy dink!

Jou vriendin vir altyd
Anika

vraag:
2.X DIALOOG

Jy ry Saterdagoggend met die bus stad toe. Jy raak aan die gesels met die bejaarde persoon langs jou, en teen die tyd dat een van julle moet afklim, het jy 'n waardevolle lewensles geleer.

Skryf die DIALOOG. Jou dialoog moet tussen 180 en 200 woorde lank wees.
beplanning: Besluit wie die twee sprekers is en hoe hulle mekaar aanspreek (register tussen 'n jongmens en 'n ouer persoon).
Laat die gesprek natuurlik begin, 'n persoonlike kwessie aanraak en geleidelik na die les toe bou.
Sorg dat die gesprek tot 'n duidelike gevolgtrekking kom: wat het die verteller geleer?
formaat: Kort scenario vooraf wat die plek en die sprekers bekendstel
Twee sprekers; naam en dubbelpunt aan die linkerkant
Elke spreekbeurt begin in 'n nuwe reël
Neweteks tussen hakies direk ná die naam en vóór die woorde
Geen aanhalingstekens nie
Informele register wat gesproke klink, maar versorg geredigeer is; geen sleng, slordige taal of sms-taal nie
Gesprek ontwikkel logies en kom tot 'n gevolgtrekking
Liggaam (scenario en sprekersname ingesluit) tussen 180 en 200 woorde (die opskrif tel nie)
antwoord:
Lerato sit Saterdagoggend op die bus stad toe. Langs haar sit 'n bejaarde man met 'n klein houtkissie op sy skoot.

Lerato: (nuuskierig) Verskoon tog, oom, maar dit is 'n pragtige kissie. Het oom dit self gemaak?
Oom Piet: (glimlag) Ja, my kind. Dit is my veertigste een. Ek bring dit vir my kleindogter wat môre twaalf word.
Lerato: Veertig? Ek het in graad 9 'n voëlhuisie probeer bou en dit het ná een week in stukke geval. Ek het nooit weer 'n hamer opgetel nie.
Oom Piet: (lag hartlik) Weet jy hoeveel van my eerste kissies in die vuur beland het? Elke mislukking het my iets nuuts geleer.
Lerato: (sug) Ek is eerlik bang om te misluk. My eindeksamen begin binnekort en ek voel of ek nie goed genoeg is nie.
Oom Piet: Niemand word met vaardighede gebore nie, my kind.
Lerato: En as ek my bes doen en dit is steeds nie genoeg nie?
Oom Piet: Dan het jy iets geleer wat jy nie anders sou leer nie.
Lerato: (glimlag) So my foute is eintlik lesse?
Oom Piet: (staan stadig op) Presies. Hier klim ek af. Onthou net: 'n mislukking is bloot 'n eerste poging.
verduideliking: Die dialoog begin met 'n kort scenario wat die plek en die twee sprekers bekendstel. Elke spreekbeurt begin in 'n nuwe reël met die naam en 'n dubbelpunt, neweteks staan tussen hakies direk ná die naam, en daar is geen aanhalingstekens nie. Die register pas by 'n gesprek tussen 'n jongmens en 'n ouer persoon: Lerato spreek hom respekvol as oom aan. Die gesprek ontwikkel logies van die houtkissie na Lerato se vrees om te misluk, en kom tot 'n duidelike lewensles wat die opdrag vereis. Algemene foute: aanhalingstekens of beskrywende verteltrant tussen die spreekbeurte, sleng of sms-taal, meer as twee sprekers en 'n gesprek wat nie tot 'n gevolgtrekking kom nie.

vraag:
2.X INFORMELE TOESPRAAK

Die munisipaliteit het 'n braakliggende erf langs die kliniek aan jou gemeenskap beskikbaar gestel. As lid van die jeugraad wil jy op dié erf 'n groentetuin begin wat behoeftige gesinne in die dorp van vars kos sal voorsien.

Jy kry die geleentheid om die inwoners by 'n gemeenskapsvergadering in die stadsaal toe te spreek. Oortuig hulle om hul tyd, kennis en hulpmiddels vir die projek beskikbaar te stel.

Skryf die INFORMELE TOESPRAAK. Jou toespraak moet tussen 180 en 200 woorde lank wees.
beplanning: Wie luister? Inwoners van alle ouderdomme, raadslede en die burgemeester. Kies 'n register wat respekvol maar warm en persoonlik is.
Begin met 'n sin wat die gehoor dadelik laat regop sit, byvoorbeeld 'n retoriese vraag of 'n treffende beeld.
Lewer twee of drie duidelike pleidooie en ondersteun elkeen met 'n rede waarom dit die gemeenskap sal baat.
Beplan 'n slot wat die pleidooie kortliks saamvat en die gehoor tot 'n konkrete aksie aanspoor.

antwoord:
SAAI VANDAG, OES MÔRE

Goeienaand, mevrou die burgemeester, raadslede en mede-inwoners.

Hoeveel kinders in ons dorp het vanoggend met 'n leë maag skool toe gestap? Die antwoord is ongemaklik, maar ons kan dit verander.

Langs die kliniek lê 'n erf vol onkruid en gebreekte bottels. Ek sien iets anders: rye spinasie, kool en tamaties wat honderd gesinne kan voed. Die munisipaliteit het die grond aan ons beskikbaar gestel. Nou het ons net hande nodig.

Eerstens vra ek die tuiniers onder u om u kennis te deel. U weet wanneer om te plant en hoe om plae te beveg; ons jongmense wil leer. Tweedens het ons gereedskap, kompos en saad nodig. 'n Ou graaf in u motorhuis kan hier 'n nuwe lewe kry. Derdens vra ek elke gesin om net een Saterdag per maand te kom help. Vele hande maak ligte werk!

Dink wat ons wen: vars kos vir die behoeftiges, 'n mooier buurt en 'n plek waar oud en jonk mekaar leer ken.

Moenie wag totdat iemand anders die eerste tree gee nie. Skryf vanaand u naam op die lys by die deur en kom saam met ons spit. Wie vandag saai, sal môre oes.

Baie dankie vir u aandag.
verduideliking: Die toespraak groet die gehoor volgens rang en begin met 'n prikkelende retoriese vraag wat die nood dadelik tuisbring. Die kontras tussen die verwaarloosde erf en die beeld van groen rye maak die doel sigbaar. Drie genommerde pleidooie (kennis, hulpmiddels, tyd) word elkeen gemotiveer, en die spreekwoord "Vele hande maak ligte werk" versterk die oproep op 'n natuurlike manier. Die slot spoor tot 'n konkrete aksie aan, eindig met 'n treffende slotsin en bedank die gehoor. Algemene foute: die gehoor word nie gegroet of bedank nie, die toespraak lees soos 'n opstel sonder direkte aanspreking, en pleidooie word gelys sonder om te motiveer waarom die gemeenskap moet help.

vraag:
2.X FORMELE VERSLAG

In jou buurt is dit snags gevaarlik om te loop, omdat baie straatligte al jare buite werking is. Die buurtvereniging het daarom 'n projek begin om sonkragligte in die donkerste strate op te rig, en jy is as projekleier aangewys.

Skryf 'n FORMELE VERSLAG aan die voorsitter van die buurtvereniging waarin jy oor die vordering van die projek rapporteer. Noem ook die probleme wat julle ondervind en doen aanbevelings.

Die verslag moet 180 tot 200 woorde lank wees.
beplanning: Gehoor: die voorsitter van die buurtvereniging, dus 'n formele, saaklike register.
Doel: feitelik rapporteer, nie oortuig of vertel nie; gebruik konkrete getalle, bedrae en datums.
Orden die inligting onder subopskrifte (vordering, uitdagings) en sluit af met uitvoerbare aanbevelings.

antwoord:
VERSLAG OOR DIE VORDERING VAN DIE SONKRAGLIGPROJEK

Aan: Mnr. D. Adams, voorsitter van die Buurtvereniging Rosedal
Van: J. Pretorius, projekleier
Datum: 2 September 2026
Onderwerp: Vordering met die oprigting van sonkragligte

Inleiding
Hierdie verslag gee 'n oorsig van die vordering wat sedert Junie met die projek gemaak is. Die doel van die projek is om twintig sonkragligte in die donkerste strate van die buurt op te rig.

Vordering
Die buurtvereniging het tot dusver R84 000 van die benodigde R120 000 ingesamel, hoofsaaklik deur 'n kermis en skenkings van plaaslike sakeondernemings. Twaalf ligte is reeds in Rivierweg en Eikelaan aangebring en werk sonder probleme. Inwoners meld dat hulle saans veiliger voel en dat minder mense in dié strate beroof word.

Uitdagings
Die projek ondervind twee probleme. Twee sonpanele is in Augustus gesteel, en die munisipaliteit het nog nie toestemming vir die oorblywende agt pale gegee nie.

Aanbevelings
Ek beveel aan dat alle panele met spesiale veiligheidsboute vasgemaak word, wat volgens 'n kwotasie R2 400 sal kos. Verder stel ek voor dat die voorsitter 'n afspraak met die wyksraadslid maak om die toestemming te bespoedig. Die oorblywende R36 000 kan deur 'n tweede kermis in Desember ingesamel word.

Slot
Die projek vorder goed, maar die laaste fase hang van die munisipaliteit se toestemming en verdere fondsinsameling af.

J. Pretorius
Projekleier
2 September 2026
verduideliking: Die verslag het 'n duidelike opskrif en 'n Aan/Van/Datum/Onderwerp-blok, en dit is onderteken met die naam, posisie en datum. Dit is vanuit die eerstepersoonsperspektief geskryf en bly feitelik en objektief: konkrete getalle (R84 000 van R120 000, twaalf van twintig ligte, R2 400) vervang vae beskrywings. Subopskrifte orden die inligting logies van inleiding tot aanbevelings, en elke aanbeveling spreek 'n genoemde probleem direk aan. Algemene foute: emosionele of oorredende taal asof dit 'n toespraak is, 'n verslag sonder opskrif of handtekening, en aanbevelings wat niks met die probleme te doen het nie.
